THE TRANSFORMER RELEASED APPROXIMATELY 10 TO 12 GALLONS OF OIL. THE TRANSFORMER IS A 25KVA CENTRAL MOLONEY UNIT MANUFACTURED IN 1976. WE ARE TREATING THIS OIL AS "ASSUMED" PCB-CONTAMINATED. THE SPILL SITE WAS FIRST DISCOVERED AT APPROXIMATELY 1040 HRS. IT WAS NOT UNTIL APPROXIMATELY 1430 HRS THAT AN OIL SHEEN WAS OBSERVED IN A SMALL CREEK LOCATED NEAR THE SPILL SITE. SUNPRO, A SPILL CLEANUP CONTRACTOR HAS BEEN CALLED IN TO ASSIST US WITH THE CLEANUP OF THIS SPILL EVENT.
